records.title: SurgicalMamba: Dual-Path SSD with State Regramming for Online Surgical Phase Recognition
records.reason: SurgicalMamba reprograms recurrent state for online surgical phase recognition with per-frame cost not growing over sequence length; the paper’s recurrent sequence-model connection is real, but evaluation/domain are surgical video and it does not demonstrate LLM inference-serving transfer.

records.title: GQA-μP: The maximal parameterization update for grouped query attention
records.reason: Derives maximal-update parameterization/scalings for grouped-query attention and tests learning-rate/weight-decay transfer across GQA settings. This is training hyperparameter theory, not an inference efficiency improvement; connection to GQA is adjacent only.

records.title: Position: Agentic AI System Is a Foreseeable Pathway to AGI
records.reason: Position/opinion paper arguing for agentic systems as an AGI pathway; no concrete evaluated compute, memory, latency or serving mechanism.

records.title: How Do Large Language Models Perform in Deep Learning Code Generation? An Empirical Study
records.reason: Title and abstract describe a non-target application, theory, or model-quality/training study without a plausible direct LLM inference compute, memory, latency, throughput, KV-cache, quantization, offload, or serving contribution.

records.title: Parallel-in-Time Training of Recurrent Neural Networks for Dynamical Systems Reconstruction
records.reason: Parallel-in-time recurrent-network training for dynamical-system reconstruction; the recurrent long-sequence link is training-algorithm context and not inference serving.
